Commentary.Commentary: The target is a massive one! However, the boundaries are short, the ball though initially did seem like not coming on the bat nicely but it eased out towards the end. Also, de Kock did mention about the dew which could come into play and if it does, South Africa would fancy themselves in the run chase. Let's hope we have an excellent run chase on our hand.

The South African bowling was decent! However, they were taken to the cleaners in the last 5 overs. That carnage towards the end ruined the figures of a few bowlers. Pretorius was pretty good in his 3-over spell. Shamsi also had a decent night. Hendricks, Ngidi and Phehlukwayo though took a real pounding.

Earlier on, after being inserted, England got off to a poor start as they lost Buttler early. Bairstow and Roy then took the attack to the bowlers and added a quickfire stand. However, both fell in quick succession. Morgan and Stokes then put up another decent stand but once again England lost Denly and Morgan in quick succession. However, Moeen Ali then came out and he smacked it right from the word go. He was timing the ball brilliantly and was clearing the fence at ease. Stokes also then got into his elements and he too started clearing the fence with ease. A 51-run stand in no time between the two took England right on top of this game.

Complete carnage in the last 5 overs! At one stage, 180 looked farfetched for the visitors but they have managed 24 runs more than that. All thanks to Moeen Ali. Yes, Ben Stokes too played a superb knock but it was Moeen Ali who provided the much-needed impetus. It seemed like he was batting on a different surface than the rest. 39 from just 11 balls and that innings could well be the difference between the two sides.

2 LEG BYES! Ngidi finally gets his length right. Bowls a perfect yorker on the boots, Stokes looks to sweep but misses. It hits his pad and rolls towards deep square leg for two leg byes. 15 runs from the over and ENGLAND FINISH WITH 204 ON THE BOARD.

Quick couple! Low full toss outside off, Stokes looks to slam it down the ground but mistimes it. It goes just over the bowler. Before the long off fielder can get to the ball, both the batters are back for the second.
SIX! Hammered! 200 up for England! This has gone way into the stand. Full and in the slot of Stokes, he connects the slog and sends it over the long on fence.
Tom Curran is the next batsman in.

OUT! Caught! This time Bavuma grabs the stunner! What a terrific catch. Third catch in the match from the little man. A short of a length ball outside off, Jordan looks to deposit it over wide long off. Bavuma from long off makes a run to his left and snaffles the ball nicely. The on-field umpire goes to the third umpire to check if the catch is clear. It looks okay. They now check the front foot too which is fine as well. So, Jordan has to go.
Full and around off, pushed to long off for a single.

FOUR! Brilliant effort at long on by Bavuma though. That could've been a stunner had he got hold of that one. Good length ball around off, Stokes clears his front leg and looks to slam it over wide long on. Bavuma runs to his left and throws himself to catch but the ball just touches his fingers and goes to the fence.
SIX! Jordan finishes the over in style! Shortish in length and outside off, Jordan reads that well and clubs it over long on for a six. 13 runs from the penultimate over.
A single now! Full and around off, Stokes looks to swing hard but mistimes it towards long on for a run.
Swing and a miss! Another length ball outside off, Phehlukwayo bowls it slow too. Stokes without any feet movement swings at the ball but connects only with thin air.
Another slower one. It is on a length and on middle, Jordan tucks it towards deep mid-wicket and brings Stokes back on strike.
A single! On middle, Stokes hits it towards deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Hammered! Length delivery and around off, Stokes smashes it over the bowler and down to the long off boundary. Top start to the over. Pressure on the bowler now.
Chris Jordan walks out to bat next. Andile Phehlukwayo to bowl the penultimate over. 3-0-32-2 are his figures so far.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ali departs but he has done his job for his side. 39 off 11 balls. Another fuller length ball around off, Ali looks to go over long on this time. He though manages a lot of height than distance. Bavuma at long on settles under it and pouches it comfortably. An excellent hand from Ali comes to an end. Expensive over from Ngidi but South Africa will be happy seeing the back of Ali.

FOUR! This time through the off side. Moeen Ali is on fire here! Ngidi goes for the yorker but ends up bowling a fuller ball outside off, Ali hammers it through the covers and the ball races away to the fence.

FOUR! Now on the leg side. Full ball on middle, Ali this time hoicks it over fine leg. The fielder is inside the ring. It goes high in the air but before the fielder can reach, the ball bounces and rolls to the fence.

SIX! How did that go over the ropes? Moeen times it really well. A low full toss outside off, Ali reaches out and lofts it over deep point for a six. He opened the bat face there and it just sailed over.
This one is very full and just outside off, Stokes whips it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a run. He wanted the second but the fielder in the deep was quick to make sure it was only a single.
FOUR! Drilled through the covers! Great start to the over for England. Full and outside off, Stokes skips down the track and slams it through covers. No chance for the man at long on.
Lungi Ngidi returns. 2-0-16-1 from him so far.

SIX! 16 from the last three balls and 21 from the over. A huge one. Probably the momentum changing over. A full ball again and on middle, this is lofted way over the long on fence for another biggie. Moeen is dealing in boundaries here.
FOUR! Moeen Ali is playing a gem of a knock here! Over the mid off fielder! 10 from the last two balls. Shorter and outside off, Ali slaps it up and over that fielder and into the long off fence.

SIX! Just over! Short boundary and Ali clears it. On the pads. Ali flicks it. For a second it seems like it is going straight into the hands of the fielder at deep square leg but it clears him quite easily.

Excellent fielding! Saves a few handy runs! A short ball but it is way too short. It goes well over the head of the batter. De Kock moves to his right, he fails to take it as it bounces just in front of him. It goes down towards the fine leg fence. Ngidi runs to his left, dives and stops it. Saves two runs for his side.
A single! Full and on middle, this is hit towards mid-wicket for one. Singles won't harm South Africa.

Ouch! That must have hurt! Stokes looks to play the paddle scoop but misses it. He gets hit on the arm where there is no protection. It goes towards short third man. A dot which is gold dust at this stage.
Shorter in length and angling into the batter. Moeen looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the body. It rolls on the off side for one.
Beuran Hendricks is back on. 2-0-24-0 are his figures so far.

Quick couple! Excellent running between the wickets! A length ball around off, Stokes pushes it towards long on with gentle hands. The call is for two and Bavuma at long on fails to pick the ball and that allows them to complete the second easily. 11 runs and a wicket from the over.
Length ball on off, it is forced to deep cover for a single.
SIX! Sailed all the way! Top shot from Moeen Ali. Another slower one and it is shortish in length. Ali reads that early and hammers it over the long on fence for half a dozen.
Good length ball around off, Stokes pushes it towards long on for a run.
Quick single! A good length ball around off, Ali taps it towards point and takes a quick run.
Moeen Ali is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! This is super bowling from Phehlukwayo. Denly fails to make an impact in this game. Phehlukwayo bowls a slower back of a length ball on middle, Denly looks to pull but is deceived by the slowness of the delivery. He misses and the ball hits his arms and then rolls onto the stumps.
Andile Phehlukwayo back on. 2-0-23-1 are his figures so far.
Another single to end! So 10 runs from the over but a wicket too. Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
A single to end! Stokes walks across and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Joe Denly is the next batsman in.

OUT! Morgan holes out! Pretorious gets the wicket he deserves. He has been really good and has troubled Morgan. Gets him finally. EM comes down the track and Pretorius bangs it short. It sticks in a surface a touch. Morgan ends up slapping it straight to the man at long off. Bavuma makes no mistake. Once again a wicket at the right time.
Stokes comes down the track and DP bowls it shorter. It is pulled down to long on for one.
SIX! That is huge! Much-needed biggie for the visitors! This is angled into the batter. Stokes heaves it right off the middle and it clears the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Shorter and on middle, Morgan guides it towards point and takes one.
A single to end! Shorter and around off, this is guided to point for one. End of Shamsi's spell. His figures 4-0-30-1. Decent outing for him.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Stokes once again looks to play the reverse sweep but misses this one which is outside off.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Poor from Hendricks! This is short and around off, Stokes pulls it down towards long on. It is uppish and there are shouts of catch it. Hendricks runs in but does not do so with full commitment. In the end he realizes he is not going to get there. Does not put his body on the line to stop it. It goes past him and into the fence.
Not off the middle and one run! Slower through the air around off. Morgan looks to play the slog sweep but is a touch early in the shot. It goes off the toe-end towards long on for one.
Quicker and outside off, just inside the tramline. Morgan slashes  but misses.
Another top over from Pretorius comes to an end. Just 4 from it. Good length ball outside off, Morgan pushes it towards point where the fielder fumbles and the batters complete an easy single.
Another length ball around off, this time Stokes taps it towards point and takes a quick run.
Slower and just outside off, Morgan waits and then guides it towards third man for a single.
Swing and a miss! Fuller length ball outside off, Morgan throws his willow at the ball but fails to connect.
Good length ball outside off, Morgan looks to cut but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.
Full and around off, Stokes comes down the track and drives it towards cover. A quick run taken.
Loopy delivery on off, Stokes punches it through covers for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Morgan looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes towards the off side. The batsmen get a run.
Short and outside off, Morgan makes room and slaps it through covers. Rassie van der Dussen in the deep slides and does well to stop it just before the ropes. The batsmen pick up a couple.
SIX! Slogged away! Full and around off from Shamsi, Morgan clears his front leg and mows the slog over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. A boundary after the 9th over. 100 up for England.
Floated delivery on middle, Stokes pulls it towards mid on for a run.
Tossed up delivery on off, Stokes plays it back towards the bowler.
A single to end a very good first over by Pretorious. Stokes eases it down to long on for one.
Looks to be innovative does Stokes! He brings out the reverse sweep to this ball outside off. Misses.
One more dot! On middle, Stokes works it to the left of the bowler who gets across and saves a run.
Slower one again and outside off, Morgan guides it towards short third man. The fielder there makes a good stop diving to his right. A single taken.
A slower one around off, Morgan looks to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge back to the bowler.
Very full and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Dwaine Pretorius into the attack now!
A wicket and then three dots to end the over! On off, it is pushed back to the bowler. A top class over from Shamsi comes to an end. 90/3 at the end of the halfway mark.
Outside off again, Morgan shapes to cut but there is extra bounce. He ends up pushing it to covers.
Slightly shorter and around off, Morgan cuts but finds point.
Ben Stokes joins Eoin Morgan out in the middle. A slip in place.

OUT! Straight to the man! Shamsi gets the well-set and the dangerous Jason Roy. Timely wicket once again. Roy uses his feet and comes down the track. He does not get to the pitch of it completely. It also turns away a touch. Roy still swings but it goes off the bottom part of the bat and straight to Miller at long on.
Down the leg side, Roy looks to sweep hard but misses.
Shorter and around off, it is cut towards point for one.
On middle, this is hit towards wide long on. Roy takes one and wants another but is sent back.
FOUR! Terrific shot. Full delivery on off, Morgan lofts it over mid off for a boundary. 9 runs have come from the over.
On a length on middle, Roy flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery on leg, Morgan pulls it through square leg for a run.
Phehlukwayo bowls it full and outside off, Morgan looks to go after it but misses it.
Short delivery on middle, Roy pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss on off, Roy drives it through wide mid off. The batsmen get two runs.
Another single to end a good over for England. On off, it is hit down to long off for one.
A single now! This is eased down to long off for one. Sensible batting.
FOUR! Good shot! Morgan plays both the sweeps well. This time it is the conventional sweep. He hits this delivery on the leg stump to the backward square leg fence.
OHHH! Roy looks to play the reverse sweep. Shamsi bowls it on middle, it hits the underedge of Roy's bat and goes towards short third man for one. Had he missed there, he was a goner.
In the air... safe! Floats it up outside off, Morgan lofts it over covers. It lands away from the sweeper and a single is taken.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Change in bowling as well as Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack.
Skipper Eoin Morgan is the new man in.

OUT! Timber! Phehlukwayo has Bairstow once again. A much-needed breakthrough as this partnership was really starting to flourish. AP is pumped up and why not. He lands this on a length and around off, Bairstow stays leg side of the delivery and looks to slash it through the off side. A poor shot as there is not a lot of room on offer. He misses and the off stump is shattered. South Africa need to keep taking wickets if they are to stem the run flow. 14 runs and wicket from Phehlukwayo's first over.
Another slower one, Roy hits it down to long off and takes one.
Bowls the yorker now, this is hit down to long off for one.
SIX! This is unreal hitting! Over the mid-wicket fence this time. Slightly short and on middle, Bairstow hangs back and picks it up. It sails over the mid-wicket fence. Consecutive biggies.
SIX! Clears the ropes again! It is full and right in the slot. Bairstow lofts it straight and over the long on fence. Raining boundaries here now.
On off, Bairstow pushes it back to the bowler.
Andile Phehlukwayo into the attack now!

FOUR! Edgy boundary! Another huge over for England and despite losing an early wicket, this is a good start for them. They are 55 for 1 after 6. Roy makes room and Hendricks follows him. He looks to guide it down to third man but gets an inside edge down to the fine leg fence.
SIX! That is an outrageous shot! Wow! 50 up in style! Roy comes down the track and BH bangs it short and outside off. Roy slaps it well over the cover fence for a biggie.
A short slower one, almost a similar delivery to which Roy got out in the last game. This time he waits, gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards mid-wicket. A dot.
Slightly shortish and it skids through after pitching on middle. Bairstow mistimes the pull towards mid-wicket for one.
Well fielded! A slower ball outside off, Bairstow guides it through point. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to two.
FOUR! Another boundary! On the fuller side again and on off, Bairstow lofts it over mid off and it goes to the fence. Ideal start to the 6th. They need to make it count now.
Beuran Hendricks returns! 1-0-7-0 from him so far.
A single to end a very good over for England! Shorter and around off, this is guided through point for one. 14 from the over, a good one for England.
A couple now! Slightly shorter in length and on middle, Bairstow pulls it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and saves two.
SIX! Just over the fence! Nicely played! A slower one, it is very full. Bairstow gets under it and hits it high and handsome. Over the long off fence. Runs starting to flow now.
On the shorter side, it is pulled through square leg for one.
Another sightscreen issue and there is another halt in play. This time it has been solved quickly.
Roy comes down the track and Ngidi bowls it outside off. He swings but misses.
EDGY FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for England! Shorter and outside off, Roy slashes at it. It flies off the outside edge and goes down to the third man fence.
FOUR! Up and over! The last ball spoils the over a little. Fuller and around off, Bairstow lofts it over mid off and bags a boundary.
Another single! On the pads, Roy looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.
A single now as this is eased down to long on. This is turning out to be another good over for the hosts.

DROPPED! A tough chance but you would expect a bowler to take that in his own bowling! This is floated up on off, Bairstow powers it uppishly to the left of Fortuin. He dives to his left, gets two hands to it but spills it. This could prove costly.
Flatter and on middle, it skids through. JB gets his bat down in time and pushes it back to the bowler.
Very full and around off, it is hit towards cover.
There is a halt in play but not sure about the exact reason! A sightscreen issue, it has been solved now and we are all set to go.
Bjorn Fortuin is back on. 1-0-9-0 are his figures so far.

Just the single to end a brilliant over from Ngidi! 2 runs and a wicket. The last ball is fuller and outside off, Ngidi is bowling to his field as he has a sweeper on the off side. Bairstow strokes it towards him and takes one. He is off the mark immediately.
Jonny Bairstow is the new batsman in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! It has been a wonderful over so far and it just gets better. Ngidi has got the big wicket of Buttler. Another low score for him. A cross-seam delivery. It is on a length and outside off, Buttler looks to hit it hard through the off side but since it is a cross-seam ball, there is extra bounce. It takes the edge and de Kock does the rest. Early wicket for the South Africans, just the start they would have wanted.
Nicely driven! On a length and around off, Buttler strokes it on the up but straight to cover. Just the 1 run from the first four balls.
On middle, Roy walks across and works it to the right of mid-wicket and takes one.
A little too wide outside off, Roy looks to stand tall and slap it but it goes off the bottom part of the bat towards mid off. Two dots to begin with.
Angled into the batter, Roy works it towards mid-wicket.
Lungi Ngidi is into the attack.
Roy makes room and also takes a step down the track. Hendricks spots that and drags his length back. Roy hits it towards mid off and takes one. So despite going for a boundary, 7 runs from the over.
On the pads again, Buttler works it through square leg for one.

Shorter and on middle, this is pushed towards mid on. Roy takes one. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. It is a little wide from the fielder backing up who dives to his left and makes a half-stop. Roy wants another but is sent back.
FOUR! Nicely tucked away! A little too straight. Roy stands tall and works it fine on the leg side for a boundary. Hendricks got away with one on the last ball but this time he pays the price.
A stifled appeal but nothing! On the pads, Roy looks to flick it fine but it brushes the pads and goes to the keeper.
Length and around off, Roy stands tall and hits it hard to covers. That went quickly off the bat. Seems a good wicket to bat on.
Beuran Hendricks to bowl from the other end.
A single to end a good first over for the visitors! Shorter and on off, it is pushed towards cover for one.
SIX! All the way! First maximum of the game! Slightly fuller this time from Fortuin and pays the price. It is fuller and on middle, Roy lofts it way over the long on fence for a biggie.
On the stumps again, Roy stays leg side of the delivery and slaps it to mid off.
Buttler gets off the mark now! This is flatter and on middle, it is eased down to long on for one.
Gives it air and bowls it full and on off, Roy strokes it towards mid off and takes one. Both Roy and England are underway.
A dot to begin! Slower through the air and around leg. Roy looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
We are all set to begin. The South African players are out in the middle. Jason Roy and Jos Buttler will open the innings for England. Bjorn Fortuin will start the proceedings for South Africa.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says they wanted to chase too as it is a good wicket and they enjoy chasing. Further adds they played good cricket in the last game but could not get over the line. He hopes they play well in this game and level the series. Also says he is happy there is no rain around. Ends by saying they will look to execute their plans here tonight and do better.

South Africa skipper, Quinton de Kock says it looks a pretty good wicket and dew might come into play later on. Mentions the boys are pretty confident and they are looking forward to this game. Informs they are disciplined and the guys have done well. Also informs Fortuin comes in for Steyn.
England (Unchanged Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (WK), Jonny Bairstow, Eoin Morgan (C), Ben Stokes, Joe Denly, Moeen Ali, Tom Curran, Adil Rashid, Chris Jordan, Mark Wood.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (C/WK), Temba Bavuma, Rassie van der Dussen, JJ Smuts, David Miller, Dwaine Pretorius, Andile Phehlukwayo, Beuran Hendricks, Tabraiz Shamsi, Bjorn Fortuin (In for Dale Steyn), Lungi Ngidi.
TOSS - Time for the spin of the coin. South Africa have won the toss and elect to field first.

A last-ball finish in the first T20I saw the hosts take a 1-0 lead in the series. Now, they have a chance to seal the series with a win here. They have momentum on their side so it will be interesting to see if they can make use of it. England on the other hand, need to win this game if they are to stay alive in this series. They lost a game which they probably should have won last time around, can they go that one step further and level it? Hello and welcome to the coverage of the second T20I. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.
